lf-file-tree.description: An optional keyboard-accessible file navigator, drawn with Pierre Trees, from a file-list source or another widget's declared files output.
lf-file-tree.x-instructions: Choose source for an independent file-list feed, or for to browse a widget that publishes a compatible files output. Selecting a file reveals its key in the referenced widget when the producer supplies one. An independent file tree keeps selection local. Directory expansion and search are local reading state, not recorded decisions.
